title: Canadian Callaloo Salad
description: A flavorful salad featuring the unique taste of callaloo and a hint of Canadian flair.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the chopped callaloo and mixed salad greens.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the Canadian balsamic vinaigrette and a pinch of salt.
3. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the salad and toss to combine.
4. Top the salad with sliced red onion and crumbled feta cheese (if using).
5. Sprinkle chopped pecans or walnuts over the salad for added crunch.
7. Refrigerate leftovers for up to 2 days.
8. Consider adding some grilled chicken or salmon for added protein.
9. For an extra burst of flavor, add some diced apple or dried cranberries.
10. Don't forget to garnish with fresh herbs, like parsley or cilantro!
